Needs permission. If no permission dialog appears: App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then turn it on again.

Only text notifications from the Messages app with 승인 · 결제 · 취소 in them are sent. Other texts and other apps\' notifications never leave the phone. Texts the server cannot read wait on the Messages screen of the admin app.
While on, the phone sends where it is every 3 minutes and shows a quiet notification. Only fixes better than 500 m are sent. The server keeps points for its keep-days setting (400 days by default).
To keep recording after the phone restarts or the app updates, allow location “All the time”.
